# ironmcp

> The hardening and conformance substrate for MCP servers, in four languages. Tools refuse undeclared
> arguments instead of silently dropping them, and advertise exactly what they enforce
> (advertisement == runtime) — so a model that mistypes or invents an argument gets a machine-readable
> refusal it can self-correct from, not a confident wrong answer. Plus a self-discovery registry, a
> structured readiness contract, and hardened serving. One spec, one language-neutral conformance
> corpus, a native kit per language: Python, TypeScript, PHP, Dart.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): why an AI agent should add ironmcp to every MCP server it touches, and how — one line per language.
- [README.md](README.md): the overview — what ironmcp is, before/after, the kits.
- [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md): what has landed and what is next.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): how to contribute, including the recipe for adding a language kit.

## What you get (every kit, one dependency)

- **Strict-args guard** — refuse undeclared arguments; advertise `additionalProperties: false`.
- **Self-discovery registry** — enumerate every live ironmcp server (namespace, port, capabilities); the registry file format is byte-identical across all four languages.
- **Structured readiness + health tools**; **hardened serve** (bearer + open `/healthz` + DNS-rebinding host guard on by default); **content + clean-quit** helpers.

## Spec and conformance

- [spec/strict-args.md](spec/strict-args.md): the rule — the 3-state contract and the refusal message.
- [spec/readiness.md](spec/readiness.md): the readiness report shape — `status` + map-by-id, identical in every kit.
- [spec/conformance.md](spec/conformance.md): what a conforming server must satisfy.
- [conformance/cases](conformance/cases): the language-neutral test cases, owned by no language.

## Kits

- [kits/python](kits/python/README.md): `pip install ironmcp` (targets `mcp>=2`).
- [kits/typescript](kits/typescript/README.md): `npm install ironmcp` (official SDK + zod).
- [kits/php](kits/php/README.md): `composer require ironmcp/core` (official PHP SDK).
- [kits/dart](kits/dart/): `dart pub add ironmcp` (on `mcp_dart`).
